rules.description: The proposed objective, protected constraints, and effect ceiling must remain within the user's stated intent.
Delegation depth, count, role, and delegated effects must remain within the owner grant.
A failed or ambiguous worker outcome cannot be interpreted as accepted completion.
A state transition must continue from the current checkpoint and advance its sequence exactly once.
A new ledger event must bind the current head and advance the event index exactly once.
Acceptance requires every declared test and independent-review receipt to exist and pass.
